title: Web Vuln Lab
subtitle: From an object ID to an authorization decision.
description: Compare vulnerable and guarded routes, then inspect seven access-control regression scenarios. Ownership, admin checks and audit events stay visible in the same case study.
lead: A controlled Spring Boot lab for comparing insecure behavior, a code repair and the assertions that check access for different users.

title: OpenList Secure Platform
subtitle: Configuration findings that can be reviewed.
description: A local security-management prototype connecting OpenList configuration checks, rule-based scoring, alerts, recommendations and API audit records.
lead: Inspect how a configuration moves through an adapter, security rules, scoring and a dashboard, with the prototype's deployment limits stated alongside it.

title: AuthGuardianPro
subtitle: Identity, roles and API permissions.
description: An identity-security prototype with login/MFA code, role checks and API-key permission tests. The case study separates implemented controls from work still needed for deployment.
lead: A source-based look at authentication, role matching and API-key permission boundaries in an existing identity-security prototype.

title: Isolated virtual lab
subtitle: Check the environment before the tool.
description: Two training guests on a private segment, with identity, routing and mutual-connectivity evidence. Includes the old target's command-compatibility problem.
lead: Check guest identity, private routing and mutual connectivity before using a security tool. Original evidence and collection roles are retained.

title: Nmap service discovery
subtitle: Read the observation and its limits.
description: A saved 1,000-port TCP scan, all 23 observed open ports, and an AppSec follow-up plan that keeps uncertain service identities explicit.
lead: Use a recorded scan to distinguish exposed services, probable product identity and weaknesses that would still need validation.
